Bindings map GEN-GRP-0402 to mov_7c55d415a9574e9ebda7 and GEN-GRP-0407 to mov_256cb0423eb6d2a77f65. The coverage rows (product-image-coverage.json:3723-3751, :11220-11249) carry the superseded labels, approval_required and journeyClass held. The render queue targets both ids (render-queue.json:5014, :7315). PRODUCT_IMAGE_CONTRACT.md:63 and V3_ACCEPTANCE_TRACE.md:44,51 misstate this as 'kept identities GRP-0425/0426'. Downgraded to P3 for three reasons. (1) The kept identities do not exist in the 420-row runtime, so borrowing the kept row's form is the only way to honour C11's form rule today. (2) The selected pixel is the same form-neutral pedestal every other lyophilized or Form-not-stated row gets, so no wrong image is possible. (3) The forward risk is an orphaned key, which the 420 pin forces a rebuild to catch. Drop part of the correction: taking the journey class from the kept identity would break C9 ('follow the server state'). Today the runtime serves these rows as classification-pending 'Request Order' (production-catalog.ts:160-161, action-policy.ts:80-86), so the fix is to follow the runtime, not the kept identity.

Confirmed, and understated: the drift already exists, it is not just a future risk. journeyClassFor (lib.mjs:226-250) reads only product.displayState, checks `!binding` before any hold, and never reads commerceHolds, variant displayState or reviewedFormulationHolds. It maps approval_required to 'held' (lib.mjs:236-238). The runtime's HELD_DISPLAY_STATES excludes approval_required (production-catalog.ts:109-116). The runtime treats those rows as classificationPending (:160-161), i.e. request_activation / 'Request Order' (action-policy.ts:80-86), and 'Apply' in the member lane (master-offerings/action.ts:260-265). So 32 of the 33 imagery-held rows are requestable at runtime, not held. They are 29 Form-not-stated rows plus Colostrum and two Tesofensine rows; the second group gets a pedestal instead of the bottle form. Conversely, the runtime holds available_this_week (production-catalog.ts:111), while imagery maps it to catalog_visible (lib.mjs:244-246); no row has that state today. This violates C9 ('visual state must follow the server state'). The GRP-0422 projection is also right: a new unbound research row would return quote_required at lib.mjs:229, while the runtime returns formulation_hold, i.e. held. The test at :337-342 matches the exact-case displayName 'CJC-1295 With DAC', which only GRP-0394 has. The other two rows are 'CJC-1295 With Dac', so the test pins GRP-0394, and GRP-0394 is itself runtime classification-pending, not held. P2 stands because this is a structural breach of an acceptance rule, even though pixels are unaffected today.
